name: Soup run
summary: A care run in a one-to-one chat: a shelf of the things the sick friend has said she likes and a paper bag; the runner taps things and they drop into the bag, 'Drop it off' folds it shut and his face travels down the road to her door, and she taps 'Got it' when it lands.
useWhen: i have the flu, i'm dying
so sick rn can someone bring me ginger ale
want me to drop off soup? what do you want
bringing you stuff after class, list it
dontUseWhen: a group shopping list for the apartment (use grocery)
several friends each bringing something to a sick friend (use soup-drop)
paying someone back for what they bought

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Soup run for Maya'

patient.description: Who's sick (a name in the chat)

runner.description: Who's bringing it (a name in the chat); only they pack and leave

quote.description: What the sick friend said, in her words; may be empty

store.description: Where the run starts, e.g. 'CVS on Elm'

by.description: When it gets there, e.g. 'by 6'; may be empty

minutes.description: How many minutes the run takes, 1 to 240

items.description: Up to six things she's said she likes, in her words
